node.title: Re: the sub-process wont exit until the parent does
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
It's been a while since I worked with raw [doc://fork]ing instead of a helper module, but as far as I can tell, your process isn't actually backgrounding itself nor [doc://waitpid|waiting] on its children. If you want to implement this yourself, I suggest a thorough read of [doc://perlipc].

For doing parallel processing, [mod://Parallel::ForkManager] is something I see recommended often.

At the moment, I mostly use [mod://Daemon::Control] for my daemons, and a while back I also used [mod://Daemon::Daemonize]. See also the FAQ [doc://perlfaq8#How-do-I-fork-a-daemon-process?], which recommends [mod://Proc::Daemon]. Alternatively, although I unfortunately haven't yet had a chance to try it out, fellow monk [afoken] often [id://1160706|recommends] [http://cr.yp.to/daemontools.html|daemontools].
